notes.text: Marrow & Co sells freeze-dried organ treats. The customer already cooks for their dog. This is food, not a veterinary drug.
Primary buyer is a home-cook pet owner, 28–44, who reads ingredient lists. They bounce on medical-sounding copy.
Q4 is gift boxes. Spring is wellness language, not medical.
Independent pet shops. MAP is $29. Do not break MAP in DTC emails.
SMS paused after complaint spike. Do not turn it back on without legal.
Jordan killed Meta prospecting 8 Mar 2026. CAC 40 to 72. Not a maybe.
June Meta audience test still negative. CAC 72 to 68. Left paused.
Email is the core channel. Frequency test in Feb 2026 is the one that worked.
